name: RoboticusDebugger
description: A library to send sensor and vector data to the Roboticus Data Visualizer app for real-time debugging and visualization. Use this library in your Arduino projects to easily visualize sensor states and vectors in real-time with the Roboticus Debugger app (https://github.com/sSpectrals/Roboticus-Data-Visualiser).
keywords: debugger, visualization, robotics, sensors, vectors, Roboticus
